entity.name: Garvit Sharma
entity.description: I am a 16-year-old independent developer from Pathankot, Punjab, India, and an Emergent Ventures grantee. I build free, privacy-first software because everyday tools should not require uploading personal files or creating an account.

projects.name: MoreThing
projects.description: Free, private browser-based tools: 32+ PDF, image, calculator and developer tools, plus a private personal desk (renewals, warranties, autopay reminders, money ledger, streaks) that stays on the device and can be locked. Files are processed in the browser, nothing is uploaded and no account is needed. Built for India, with rupees, lakh/crore, GST, EMI and SIP built in.

channels.description: Please email for bank transfer details.

plans.name: FOSS United grant: MoreThing v1.0 (6 months)
plans.description: Estimated 6-month budget: Maintainer stipend, 6 months at Rs 40,000: Rs 240,000; Independent security review of the encrypted desk and backups: Rs 50,000; Accessibility fixes: Rs 30,000; Hosting, Cloudflare and domain, 12 months: Rs 24,368. Total: Rs 344,368. Milestones: Month 2 - full documentation, contributor guide and tests for the PDF and image tools. Month 4 - accessibility fixes (WCAG 2.1 AA) and Hindi and Punjabi interface. Month 6 - security review completed and published, v1.0 release with changelog. I will post a public progress update on the FOSS United forum every quarter.

plans.name: FLOSS/fund: yearly support for MoreThing
plans.description: Estimated 12-month budget: Maintainer stipend, 12 months at Rs 50,000: Rs 600,000; Contributor and design stipend, 6 months at Rs 30,000: Rs 180,000; Independent security audit of the encrypted desk and backups: Rs 230,000; Accessibility audit and fixes: Rs 120,000; Translation into all 22 scheduled Indian languages and major international languages: Rs 210,000; Hosting, Cloudflare Workers paid plan and domain, 12 months: Rs 48,736; Test devices only: iPhone and iPad, to build and test MoreThing on Apple devices: Rs 160,000. Total: Rs 1,548,736. Milestones: Quarter 1 - security audit and fixes; Quarter 2 - iOS and iPad testing and fixes; Quarter 3 - translations into Indian and international languages; Quarter 4 - accessibility audit, v2.0 release and public report.
